confidence_scope: Observed bounded development screen and STOP_CURRENT_CONFIGURATION; not a population equivalence or universal method impossibility claim.

what_results_support: Completed fresh own-current-policy PG-global/PG-cond and matched continued_SL_A1 comparison with exact shared initialization, no neural Critic, and fully counted requests/real updates.
Both endpoints fail preregistered complete-route benefit gate; PG-cond vs FrozenSL/PG-global raw_J and common-H J savings are0 with [0,0] descriptive parent intervals in both exposed cohorts.
128 development vs continued_SL_A1 has tiny opposite-sign raw/H effects, no strictly positive lower CI and no0.5% gain;8x8 common-H J also fails no-point-regression condition.
Valid complete routes under saved proxy model constraints and successful engineering transaction/export checks; those are separate from quality gains.
Conditional centering changes observed pooled scalar return-reference dispersion; does not demonstrate policy-gradient variance or planning improvement.
what_results_dont_support: Useful B-cond route gain versus B-global, FrozenSL or matched continuation SL.
Isolated A1/distance-feature efficacy, large-parent DRL/frozen-local goal achievement, unseen-parent/multi-seed generalization, or real IK/robot certification.
Native-H component attribution or a no-native-H control; fresh-process cold-start or PG-cond latency superiority.
missing_evidence: Positive prespecified full-route benefit over required matched controls.
Unexposed parent/task and multi-seed evidence needed for any future generalization claim.
Native intermediate pre/postprocessing routes not comprehensively captured, so standalone native-H gain is unidentifiable from this run.
